item.text: {"outcome":"pass","rationale":"The candidate directly and correctly explains the required API call and supports it with the preserved bundle. `flag_groups.go:62-77` contains `func (c *Command) MarkFlagsMutuallyExclusive(flagNames ...string)` and explicitly says Cobra errors if more than one flag from the set is used.
